It is not an agenda for a city council meeting and does not contain any information about agenda items, public hearings, or policy decisions.

transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN. TEXAS
1023
1023
THE STATE OF TEXAS (
PROOF OF DELIVERY TO MEMBERS OF THE COUNCIL
COUNTY OF TRAVIS (
Before me, the undersigned authority, on this day personally appeared Fred A. Masch, Jr.,
known to me to be the person whose name is subscribed below, and being duly sworn, on his
oath deposes and says that he delivered a copy of the foregoing notice to each of the
members of the City Council, at the time and in the manner indicated, as follows: To Mayor
Drake, at 5:15 P.M., on December 5, 1952, by delivering a copy to him in person.
To Councilman Johnson, at 5:45 P.M., on December 5, 1952, by delivering a copy to him in
person.
To Councilman Long, at 9:00 P.M., on December 5, 1952, by delivering a copy to her in
person.
To Councilman MacCorkle, at 6:15 P.M., on December 5, 1952, by delivering a copy to his
residence.
To Councilman White, at 7:00P.M., on December 5, 1952, by delivering a copy to him in
person.
(S) Fred A. Masch, Jr.
Subscribed and sworn to by Fred A. Masch, Jr., this 23rd day of February, 1953.
(S) Stanley E. Cowin
Notary Public in and for
Travis County, Texas
